# Workflow Quick Reference

## Files
- `ci.yml` - Main CI pipeline (lint, build, test, typecheck)
- `cd.yml` - Deployment pipeline with health checks  
- `security.yml` - Security scanning (dependencies, secrets, SAST, containers)
- `backup.yml` - Database backup automation
- `_reusable/setup-node.yml` - Reusable Node.js setup component

## Workflow Status
You can check the status of workflows in the [Actions tab](../../../actions).

## Quick Commands
```bash
# Trigger manual backup
gh workflow run backup.yml -f backup_type=full

# Check workflow status
gh run list --workflow=ci.yml --limit=5
```
